release_name: A monthly exposition was being shown every week
notes: Promotes beta v27.6.16. Found by testing the occurrence-rule engine for the first time: 28 ruled rows checked across 1,249 dates against an independently written expectation. 26 were correct; 2 were wrong on 40 of 52 Fridays. Saint-Paul (Phoenix) and Saint-Patrice (Plaine Magnien) both carried First Friday only; Exposition du Saint-Sacrement in special_rule with occurrence_rule empty. The app deliberately ignores a special_rule mentioning exposition or adoration so a description is never mistaken for a schedule rule, but that string was both at once, so the rule was discarded and every Friday counted - a monthly exposition was advertised all year. The ordinal now sits in occurrence_rule, as it does on all 26 working rows. Both rows are Non-Mass, so they appear only when other celebrations are included; no Mass time was affected. 426 rows, 121 sites.
